svg.text: Vertex is a web page, not a download. Open the link, add it to your
home screen, and it opens full-screen like any other app.
Scan the code, or type the address into your phone's browser.
In Safari, tap Share. In Chrome, tap the three dots.
Full-screen, no browser bar, and it still works on bad wi-fi.
Every other campus map stops at the front door.
Vertex takes you to the room, indoors, floor by floor.
An independent student project. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by George Mason
